items.prompt:
Straight-down orthographic plan photograph of a built live-action film set: camera axis exactly perpendicular to the ground; no wall face, no elevation, no side of any building or tree trunk is visible; only the ground plane, the top edges of walls, the tops of roofs, furniture and tree crowns are seen. The top of the image is north. The crown of one tall English oak rising above an unbroken sea of rounded green midsummer tree crowns that fill the whole image to every edge. At the centre the oak's top fork holding a loose flat empty nest of crossed dry grey twigs about sixty centimetres across; two thick grey lichened upper limbs splay from the fork toward the upper left (west) and upper right (east) in organic S-curves; just below and slightly right of the nest a small ragged torn gap in the leaves with snapped twigs showing dark depth below. The surrounding oak, beech and ash crowns are packed edge to edge in soft swells running in long flowing curves; deep and pale greens with gold-lit leaf edges. Sun high from the left (west), crisp leaf shadows falling right. No clearings, fields, hedges, houses, roads or any man-made object anywhere; no eggs in the nest. Clean base image for a layout plan: no people, no animals, no birds, no creatures, no text, no labels, no arrows, no grid lines, no compass.
 Photorealistic live-action fantasy film rooted in England in 1862, shot on 35mm film with anamorphic lenses, 16:9 widescreen. Real sets, real locations and real costumed actors in 1862 dress. Wonderland spaces are real built sets and set extensions in an Alphonse Mucha-inspired Art Nouveau design: flowing organic lines, floral and vine ornament, circular halo roundels, mosaic and stained glass, aged pastel-and-gold surfaces with patina and moss; the waking 1862 meadow stays plain period realism. Talking animals and fantastical creatures are photoreal CGI animals with naturalistic anatomy, real fur, feathers, skin and scales, lit by the same light and grounded with real contact shadows. Natural and practical light: sunlight, candlelight and oil lamps, soft haze with volumetric light shafts and soft colour through stained glass. Restrained palette of verdigris teal, slate grey, dusty rose, soft sage and lilac pastels and tarnished-gold accents, warmed by amber sun and candle glow. Fine film grain, gentle halation, soft depth of field, grounded and quietly melancholy.
